title: Failing test and read-only endpoint: the real skills store as JSON
goal: GET /api/skills returns what nerv skills list returns, plus each skill's stage and latest evaluation
acceptance: Owner decision 2026-11-26 in chat: "y" to the skills panel and pre-flight skill plan (earlier: "pre flight check, ok", real data).

A failing test (committed first) stages a skill in a temporary home with src/skills.ts and expects GET /api/skills to list it; today the route does not exist and the dashboard shows only a placeholder

GET /api/skills is read-only and answers admin and read-only clients like GET /api/pilots (it sits with the other read endpoints, before the admin-only block); it returns, per skill, id, title, domain, versions (version, status, stagedAt, promotedAt), the active version, and the latest evaluation report of each version against its baseline (pass counts for with-skill and baseline, regression and holdout, eligibleForPromotion), read from the store (listSkillPackages and the version records), never invented

The stage is derived once, here, and written in the endpoint's text: seed = staged and not yet evaluated, sprout = staged with an evaluation, ripe = active, dropped = retired or rolled back (the F-051 tabs: Seed, Sprout, Ripe, Dropped); an empty store returns {"skills":[]}, a corrupt registry returns an error the panel can show, not an empty list
No skill instructions or scripts are returned (names, versions and numbers only)
privacy: Neutral invented skills, fleets, spots and weather only; no owner data, tokens or coordinates of a real place in Git or tests.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner
A visible change in how a section looks or behaves goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26: one read route over the existing registry and report types, plus the stage rule and tests. Not a measurement. Closed 2026-11-27: #846 merged on green CI (run 45912067128).
